1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in FIR/Case Crime No.338 of 2024 under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 POCSO Act P.S. Reusa District Sitapur.

entities.text: POCSO Act P.S. Reusa District Sitapur
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report alleging that the daughter of the informant aged about 16 years was enticed by the applicant and she had taken some money and jewellery with her.
4.
In the two statements the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that both of them had gone to Punjab and had also married.
The victim refused to undergo medical examination.
5. Considering the two statements not supporting the prosecution story, as such, the applicant who has no criminal history and is in custody since 21.07.2024 is entitled for the bail.

sentences.text:
6. Let the applicantRamu Nishad be released on bail in aforesaid FIR/Case Crime Number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
